request.style: English, sea shanty, a rough male crew singing in unison with a lead calling the lines, heavy foot stomps, accordion, fiddle and bodhrán, hearty tavern sound, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
No sun, no stars for many days
Keep up your courage, men
The storm was raging on the waves
Keep up your courage, men
We gave up hope of being saved
Keep up your courage, men
Then Paul stood up and spoke to us
Keep up your courage, men

[Chorus]
An angel stood beside me in the night
Not one of you will be lost
Only the ship, only the ship
Not one of you will be lost

[Verse]
We struck a sandbar in the bay
Keep up your courage, men
The stern was broken by the waves
Keep up your courage, men
Some swam and some on planks of wood
Keep up your courage, men
And every soul came safe to land
Keep up your courage, men

[Chorus]
An angel stood beside me in the night
Not one of you will be lost
Only the ship, only the ship
Not one of you will be lost
